author: tomas
text: Plan 063 (tier S, frontend/App.tsx only + new App.reconnect.test.tsx): replace onStatus=setConnected with handleStatus. Drop while streamingRef: end turn locally (partial text -> agent message once, cards/pending cleared, orphan proposals as loose like the error frame, streamStore flushed, setError note 'Connection lost, the answer may be incomplete.' in the existing error line), remember convId; on the next open reload only if that conv is still active and no new turn started (turnSeq), else skip; failure keeps partial+note and retries on next open; if the reload has no agent reply (backend restart lost it) re-append the kept partial. Stray turn frames (token/tool/done/error) ignored when not streaming. Backend already persists a partial on WebSocketDisconnect (ws.py _persist_partial) but only when the process survives and notices the drop; a backend restart saves nothing.

author: nils
text: 061 root cause (sc-428), measured without credentials: on the GLOBAL Vertex endpoint every :predict request on a FRESH connection takes ~11.8 s (curl and httpx, even the 401 reply; 3/3 runs; embedContent and generateContent paths ~1.1 s). Same connection after that: ~1.1 s. Regional endpoints (europe-west1/4, us-central1): ~1.3-1.9 s fresh. httpx drops idle connections after 5 s, so a query embedding (after idle) always opens a fresh connection and hits the 3 s timeout. Tempo agrees: the first indexer request of each burst takes ~12 s (200), the rest ~450 ms on the warm connection; the chat-turn query POSTs were cancelled at 2-3 s. google-genai sends gemini-embedding-001 to :predict on Vertex (t_is_vertex_embed_content_model excludes it). So: not sequential requests, not client setup, not the retry policy; raising the timeout would make every search ~12 s.

author: nils
text: Plan 061 (tier S). (1) sc-428: embeddings run at their own Vertex location, new setting kb_embed_location (default europe-west1, the documented general region; empty = the model location). generation.embed_texts gains location=, served by a cached per-location genai client; VertexEmbedder passes settings.kb_embed_location. Test pins it: embed requests go to the configured location, chat clients stay on WCL_MODEL_LOCATION. (2) sc-319: VertexEmbedder sends RETRIEVAL_QUERY requests concurrently (bounded by 5, the max queries); documents stay sequential so the background indexer's load on the quota is unchanged. Test: slow fake, 4 queries, wall time ~1 request. (3) sc-503: record the request in except BaseException (cancelled -> error.type CancelledError, a fixed class name the allowlist already passes via error.type), then re-raise; one record per request. Test: provider fake slower than search's budget. Timeout stays 3.0 s unless the live pass shows regional fresh > 3 s.

author: ansel
text: 062 sc-504 root cause (measured on live Mimir, read-only, Grafana 13 graphTransform.ts from the tempo plugin's source map): node avg = sum rate(server_seconds_sum) / sum rate(request_total) over edges INTO the node. Two causes: (a) redis/unknown are virtual_node servers: the servicegraph connector records their server latency as 0 (live: redis server_sum 0, client 6.3 ms/r) -> '0.00 ms/r'. Fix: the copy takes client_* for virtual_node edges with a real client, server_* elsewhere (virtual client 'user' -> api keeps its real server side). (b) api's only incoming edge is user->api (browser spans are kept out of the connectors), ~23 requests/day, so short ranges show none: low traffic, not a bug (6h range: api 1162 ms/r). wcl (Postgres db.name, connection_type database) is correct (~1-3 ms/r). Stack assertion in provisioning.sh: api ~50 ms, redis ~20 ms.

author: nils
text:
Maren: I can't make that call myself: my binding agent rules say developers make no live LLM calls and never touch the owner's credentials; team-lead runs the live pass (no agent message can lift that). So I've made it a 30-second first step for team-lead, run before anything else, from the owner checkout with the app env loaded: uv run python -c "import asyncio,math,time; from wcl_agent.llm import generation as g; from wcl_agent.llm.model_retry import RetryPolicy as P
async def m():
 r={}
 for loc in ('europe-west1','global'):
 t=time.monotonic(); v=(await g.embed_texts('gemini-embedding-001',['best trinkets for a fire mage'],task='RETRIEVAL_QUERY',dimensions=768,policy=P(attempts=1),location=loc))[0]; r[loc]=v; print(loc,len(v),round(time.monotonic()-t,2),'s')
 a,b=r.values(); print('cosine',sum(x*y for x,y in zip(a,b))/math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in a)*sum(y*y for y in b)))
asyncio.run(m())". Expect: europe-west1 768 dims in ~1-2 s (fresh connection), global 768 in ~12 s, cosine ~1.0. If europe-west1 refuses the model (404), the fallback is one env line, KB_EMBED_LOCATION=us-central1 (or europe-west4), re-run the same check with that location. Two calls, a few tokens.
